tasks.text: In a grid of streets, E is at the top-left corner at coordinates (0,4) and G is at the bottom-right corner at (5,0). If you can only travel down or right along the grid lines, how many 9-step paths are there from E to G that pass through the point F at (3,3)?
tasks.original_text: How many 9 step paths are there from $E$ to $G$ which pass through $F$?[asy]size(4cm,4cm);int w=6;int h=5;int i;pen p=fontsize(9);for (i=0; i<h; ++i){draw((0,i) -- (w-1,i));}for (i=0; i<w; ++i){draw((i, 0)--(i,h-1));}label("G", (w-1,0), SE, p);label("E", (0,h-1), NW, p);label("F", (3,3), NE, p);[/asy]
